title: Sage block record
description: A block record (BlockRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another block record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

arcDegrees.description: How wide the guard covers, centred on the way the defender faces; 360 = all round. Unit: °. Range: 0 to 360. (float, default 120)

reduction.description: The fraction of a blocked blow's damage and knockback the guard stops; 1 = all of it. Range: 0 to 1. (float, default 1)

directional.description: Blocks only a blow coming the way the guard faces (AttackStance.Direction against the swing's), as Warband; a guard or a swing with no direction matches any. (bool, default false)

stamina.description: The attribute a block spends (stamina), through its spendEffect; empty = blocking is free. Names a attribute record. (RecordRef<AttributeRecord>)

staminaCost.description: Stamina each blocked blow costs. At least 0. (float, default 0)

staminaPerDamage.description: And per point of damage the guard stopped. At least 0. (float, default 0)

guardBreakStagger.description: How long a defender who cannot pay for a block is staggered when its guard breaks. Unit: s. At least 0. (float, default 0.5)

parryWindow.description: A blow met this soon after the guard went up is parried: nothing lands, nothing is spent; 0 = never. Unit: s. At least 0. (float, default 0)

parryStagger.description: How long a parried attacker is staggered. Unit: s. At least 0. (float, default 0.6)

blockTrigger.description: The trigger set on the defender's animator when it blocks a blow. Category: Presentation. (string, default "")

parryTrigger.description: The trigger set on the attacker's animator when its blow is parried (its recoil) Category: Presentation. (string, default "")

blockCue.description: Raised where a blow is blocked (the clang) Names a cue record. Category: Presentation. (RecordRef<CueRecord>)

parryCue.description: Raised where a blow is parried. Names a cue record. Category: Presentation. (RecordRef<CueRecord>)
